title: Open-orbit category and its underlying-set functor
statement: Let $G$ be a topological group, with $G$ and its coset sets in $\mathbf{Set}_u$. Let $G\text{-}\mathbf{Set}_{\mathrm{disc}}$ be the category [def-nagata-category] of all discrete continuous left $G$-sets in this universe and all equivariant maps. For each open subgroup $U\subseteq G$, give $G/U$ its discrete quotient topology and its continuous left translation action. Define $\mathcal O_G$ as the small category indexed by open subgroups, with $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_G}(U,V)$ all $G$-equivariant maps $G/U\to G/V$, and composition and identities those of maps. The canonical inclusion $i_G$ sends $U$ to the action $G/U$ and keeps all arrows. Define $F_G:G\text{-}\mathbf{Set}_{\mathrm{disc}}\to\mathbf{Set}_u$ by forgetting the action and topology, and $\omega_G=F_G\circ i_G$ as the underlying-set functor on $\mathcal O_G$.

source.place: Proposition 7.1.5, printed p. 64: the collection of open subgroups and the equivariant maps between G/U, and determination of the full forgetful functor by these orbit sets.
